purpose: Provide one reusable VERIFY/QA block for existing worker packets, Guide/Integrator/Judge and Primary Chat projection without creating scheduling, acceptance, promotion or version authority.
selection_rule: Choose the cheapest sufficient depth. Browser/image lanes are required only when served behavior, interaction, visual risk, authority/safety risk or other acceptance vectors cannot be proven deterministically.

candidate_visibility.rule: A candidate/preview may remain visible while expensive QA is pending when existing safety/acceptance policy does not require gating.

disposition.pass: Produce evidence and either READY_TO_PROMOTE when existing policy requires human acceptance, or an auto-promotion-permitted signal only when existing policy already grants that authority.
disposition.fail: Materialize one bounded repair successor through existing Guide/Integrator/CURRENT after semantic dedup; reverify the repaired candidate.
disposition.boundary: Record QA_BLOCKED with exact missing capability/authority/evidence; do not manufacture PASS.

acceptance: published HTML carries content-derived ?v=<sha12> for progress-v1.js
staged gh-pages asset bytes equal source asset bytes
stable unversioned or wrong-version served reference is FAIL

primary_chat_projection.rule: Only render compact QA detail when an eligible projected return carries a valid qa envelope. Do not add QA noise to unrelated messages.

PCI-041: PRODUCER -> E6 VERIFY -> JUDGE/DISPOSITION -> repair/reverify -> existing promotion authority

invariants: QA evidence never becomes scheduling authority.
QA evidence never silently promotes a candidate.
No parallel version registry is introduced.
No browser or image verification is required when deterministic evidence is sufficient.
Every material FAIL creates a grounded repair successor or an explicit non-actionable/boundary disposition.
Raw private human content remains outside the public repository.
